declared_input_requirements.raw_genomic_files: inventory-only; raw VCF contents are not parsed or checksummed

missing_input_rules: If metadata is absent, allow dry-run QC/PCA planning but block population-label interpretation.
If reference build is absent, flag reproducibility uncertainty.
If VCF is absent, do not select this recipe.
preflight_checks: Confirm raw genomic files remain inventory-only.
Require human expert review before interpreting any PCA, ADMIXTURE, FST, ROH, or selection output.

dry_run_steps.title: Inventory declared VCF
dry_run_steps.description: Record declared VCF path/name and metadata path/name without parsing raw VCF contents.

dry_run_steps.title: Preview VCF-to-PLINK conversion
dry_run_steps.description: Render a non-executed conversion preview for later human review.

dry_run_steps.title: Preview QC, LD pruning, PCA, and optional ADMIXTURE K sweep
dry_run_steps.description: Render dry-run planning steps for sample/SNP QC, LD pruning, PCA, optional ADMIXTURE, reproducibility notes, and safety interpretation notes.

command_preview_templates.preview: plink --vcf {vcf_inventory_name} --make-bed --out {dry_run_prefix} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.

command_preview_templates.description: Dry-run preview for QC, LD pruning, and PCA.
command_preview_templates.preview: plink --bfile {dry_run_prefix} --indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2 --out {dry_run_prefix}; smartpca -p {dry_run_parfile} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.

allowed_with_review: A VCF-derived population-structure workflow can be planned as dry-run previews.
soften: Convert structure claims into tentative exploratory patterns requiring metadata and human review.
block: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components

blocked_interpretations: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components
scientific_validity_notes: Dry-run command previews do not imply that PLINK, ADMIXTURE, smartpca, vcftools, or any external genomics tool was executed.
external_llm_called=false by default; external_tools_executed=false; raw genomic files are inventory-only.
PCA and ADMIXTURE require LD pruning, sample metadata, QC context, and human expert review before interpretation.
human_review_checklist: Human expert review required: confirm VCF build, cohort design, metadata, and QC assumptions.
Confirm PCA clusters are not identity labels and ADMIXTURE components are not literal ancestry.
Confirm clinical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, consumer ancestry, caste/community/religion, genetic purity/superiority, unsupported selection, and unsupported endogamy claims are blocked.
